You should try the following : check your connection, disable ad-blocker, clear your browser cache, try in private mode, try from another browser/computer/connection. 0 Get the MacGuffin The game Get the MacGuffin is a quick and humorous deduction game involving hand management and player elimination. The goal is to be the last player with cards. The player with the MacGuffin card will frequently win the game, but holding onto that card can prove quite difficult! Also, because there are 23 cards in the deck and players are always dealt an equal number of cards, there will always be some cards that are not in play. Figuring out which cards are missing is part of the strategy! It was nominated for the 2019 Origins Awards Best Card Game. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Overview The aim is to be the last player still with cards Cards Objects must be played to the table as your turn and later used for special power: MacGuffin: Pass as your turn if you have no other cards Backup MacGuffin: pass as your turn if you have no other cards, unless MacGuffin is in play The Money: Discard to take another object or a card in someone's hand The Crown: Pass as your turn unless any MacGuffin is in play The Paper: Discard this or The Rock The Rock: Discard this or The Scissors The Scissors: Discard this or The Paper Play Actions and do what it says: The Spy: Look at another player's hand of cards Vortex: Shuffle all players' hands together and deal them back out Wheel of Fortune: All players pass their hands in clockwise or counterclockwise direction The Switcheroo: Trade hands with another player Can I Use That?: Take a random card from another player's hand and play it The Assassin: Discard Crown if it's in play, otherwise discard any Object or a random card Tomb Robbers: Add random card from unused card pile to your hand Garbage Collector: Take card of choice out of discard pile and add it to your hand The Thief: Steal an object or a random card and put it in your hand The Interrogator: The holder of the MacGuffin or the Backup Macguffin must reveal it The Merchant: If just one player has an Object, steal one, otherwise make an exchange I'm Not Dead Yet!: If you have no other cards, steal a non-MacGuffin Object or a card from someone's hand The Fist of Doom: Discard an Object in play. community_text:
[Rating: 1/10] Terrible at two. It's one of those games which relies on randomness and player attitude to be fun at all. I could see this being silly fun but it doesn't seem worth the effort.

[Rating: 1/10] Abysmal short game. It is as if someone had been paid to make a game for Looney Labs and completely forgot about it so they bought a deck of cards and wrote random goofy things on it 5 minutes before having to show them a finished product. There is a lot of games that take this time that give you a lot more.

[Rating: 1/10] I'll give this game another try.  Perhaps at higher play counts its better.  But the few times I've played its stunk.  There's barely any strategy and I hate (I mean hate) the three cards which are simply wave as you play (or give the peace sign and whatever the third one is).  To me, that just seems lazy.  Think of another three cards.  C'mon.

[Rating: 1/10] Awful game with old game design decissions - cards which do nothing for the game state, but with specific humor like a "shrug your shoulders when you play this card". I hope such games fade into oblivion and never appear again.

[Rating: 2/10] Get the MacGuffin borders on not even being a game. It feels like pure randomness that eventually leads to someone 'winning' and the game simply ending.
